project: CuteCut Pro - Surah Mulk Text Lag Forensic Analysis

phenomenon_assessment.observed_behavior: When one ayah timing becomes wrong, the text goes behind the recitation.

direct_causes.ayah_start_late: Yes, the next ayah's start boundary is pushed late due to the preceding pause being absorbed by the previous verse.
direct_causes.previous_ayah_end_late: Yes, the previous ayah's end boundary is placed too late.
direct_causes.previous_ayah_too_long: Yes, the previous ayah's duration is overly prolonged, overflowing into the next verse.
direct_causes.next_ayah_too_short: No, the next ayah's duration is relatively correct, but its start is shifted late.
direct_causes.text_mapped_to_wrong_ayah: No, the text mapping is 100% correct in terms of sequential Uthmani order.
direct_causes.timing_error_cumulative: No, the error is local and does not accumulate permanently into a global offset.
direct_causes.engine_recovers_automatically: Yes, the engine recovers automatically at the next high-confidence silent pause anchor point.

phenomenon_assessment.technical_justification: The Quran text mapping itself remains entirely correct (there is no SEQUENCE/TEXT MAPPING ERROR where verses get mapped to wrong identities). The lag is purely a local temporal boundary error where the terminal pause boundary of the previous ayah is pushed forward in time, causing its Arabic text and English translation to linger on the screen while the audio recitation of the next verse has already begun.
